title: Hanscom’s Execution & Rapid Operations (HERO)- Industry Day
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND > AIR FORCE LIFE CYCLE MANAGEMENT CENTER > FA2835 AFLCMC HANSCOM PZI
description:
Join the Department of the Air Force and the 66th Air Base Group (66 ABG) at the Hanscom Conference Center for an interactive HERO (Hanscom’s Execution & Rapid Operations) Industry Day. This event is designed specifically to help local and regional commercial construction groups navigate 10 U.S.C. § 2808a, a new, flexible statutory authority for military facility construction and repair that operates entirely outside standard Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) rules. We will preview the FY27 Hanscom AFB construction and renovation pipeline—featuring 9 upcoming projects valued between $2.5M and $50M—and discuss streamlined, commercial-style delivery methods like Progressive Design-Build (PDB) and Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) pricing. 

  

 Please review the following event details: 

 
	 Date: Monday, December 14, 2026 
	 Location: Hanscom Conference Center, B1106, 25 Grenier St., Hanscom AFB, MA 01731 
	 Time: 09:00 AM – 11:00 AM EST (Doors open at 08:30 AM for registration, coffee, and morning networking). 
	 Point of Contact (POC): Patrick Monagle (patrick.monagle@us.af.mil) and Courtney Petterson (courtney.petterson@us.af.mil) 
 

  

 Action Required: Confirm your organization's attendance by 7 December 2026 for our final head count to the POCs above with the name(s) of the individuals that you will have in attendance. Attendees should plan to be at the new HAFB Visitor Center a minimum of 30-45 minutes prior to the start time to obtain your Visitors Pass. A Government representative from our office will be there to meet you beginning at 7:45 a.m. (EDT). 

 All attendees must have a Government issued REAL ID i.e., driver’s license. All those who are driving on base must bring a valid driver’s license, proof of auto insurance, and registration of vehicle being driven on base. We look forward to partnering with you to modernize tomorrow's defense infrastructure. 

 **If the Government is in a shutdown, this will be rescheduled. 

  DIRECTIONS:  

  Directions to HAFB Visitor Center:  Take Exit 46B off I-95/Rte 128, Hanscom Field Exit, go 1 1/2 miles to the blinking light, take a right, go 1/4 mile straight, bear right to Hanscom AFB, Vandenberg Gate, and check in at the visitor center. 
 
 Directions to Hanscom From Logan International Airport (Boston):  As you depart Logan Airport follow the signs to the Massachusetts Turnpike, I-90. I-90 will take you through the Ted Williams Tunnel ($3 toll). Stay on I-90 until you reach I-95/Rte 128. There will be $2 in tolls. Take I-95 North toward Peabody. From Rte I-95 proceed to Exit 46B (visitors/personnel with no DoD vehicle sticker) or Exit 49B (DoD stickers and ID cards). See above for further details. Logan Airport/Boston is approximately 25 miles from Hanscom. 
 
 From Points South:  Take I-95 North or the Massachusetts Turnpike (I-90 - a toll road) to I-95/128 North. Take either Exit 46B (Visitors) or Exit 49B (Note: Exit 49B is the only gate open past 10 p.m.)
